craft_notes: Sthāyin: kutaḥ-battery opens (summon/seat/wash/sip). Rows: row 3 (where→sip?). Close: sipping (ācamana as landing: smallest rite closes). Rejected: grouping the four — kept each asked separately (the battery IS the form); 'temple' props — kept none (no props named).

lines: For the full, whence the call? For the all-homed, whence a seat?
For the clean, foot-water and honors? For the pure, sipping?
l4.sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasyāvāhanaṃ kutra sarvādhārasya cāsanam | svacchasya pādyamarghyañca śuddhasyācamanaṃ kutaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Where is the seat for the all-based? → The kutaḥ series opens: summoning, seating, washing, sipping — each rite asked where, for whom without place.
c1_essence: Summoning, seating, washing, sipping — each rite asked where, for whom without place.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling into established holding (stillness that stays)
